project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test whether the positive R3H opening-dislocation pocket can be expanded causally by denser sampling inside the opening regime while preventing weaker later-session reentries. This is structurally distinct from failed R3I broad first-half propagation.

predecessor_evidence.R3H: Q0.70 opening checkpoints produced 15 executed 2023 trades with net3 +6.0012bps PF2.6153 and net5 +4.0012bps PF1.8877, but insufficient count/month robustness.
predecessor_evidence.R3I: Broadening identical Q0.70 logic through 13:00 produced 55 trades with net3 -1.7025bps PF0.8654; 2024 remained unopened.
predecessor_evidence.inference_used_for_design: Preserve the opening-localized hypothesis; do not propagate into midday. Increase temporal resolution only inside 09:45-10:30 and permit at most the first qualifying event per trading date.

signal.candidate_direction: sign of NIFTY causal 30-minute return at checkpoint; positive=CE, negative=PE
signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
signal.gap_condition: abs NIFTY opening gap >= previous-history Q0.70
signal.momentum_condition: abs NIFTY causal 30-minute return >= previous-history Q0.70
signal.sensex_confirmation: SENSEX causal 15-minute return has same sign as candidate
signal.vix_confirmation: India VIX causal 15-minute return has opposite sign to candidate
signal.session_location_confirmation: CE requires NIFTY session_pos>=0.65; PE requires session_pos<=0.35
signal.first_event_rule: scan checkpoints chronologically and accept the first qualifying event only; later same-date events are ignored even if the trade would have exited

horizon_router.trend_threshold: median over previous 126 completed trading-date observations at same checkpoint

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze configuration, then and only then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3J and do not open 2024; preregister a distinct R3K before any R3K output

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
